summary:
SindyLink: Mission THRESHOLD is an interactive Mars exploration and astronaut training experience designed to introduce young learners to the challenges of living and working on another planet.

Developed for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, the project transforms space science into an immersive, mission-based learning adventure.

Players become commanders of the NEXUS Mars outpost, where they must manage essential resources including oxygen, water, food, energy and materials while completing scientific experiments, deploying rovers and maintaining critical systems.

Built using Unreal Engine 5, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and Node.js, SindyLink combines a 3D Martian environment with an interactive mission-control dashboard and IVY, a Super Intelligence Agent.

Inspired by NASA's real-world Mars exploration resources, the experience encourages problem-solving, critical thinking, teamwork and an understanding of space exploration.
details:
SindyLink: Mission THRESHOLD

NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 — Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

SindyLink: Mission THRESHOLD is an immersive Mars exploration and astronaut training simulation designed to inspire young learners through interactive STEM education.

Players become Mission Commander of NEXUS, a futuristic outpost within the fictional AEGIS settlement on Mars. Their mission is to maintain a functioning base, protect their crew and complete scientific objectives.

How It Works

Built in Unreal Engine 5, the simulation allows players to explore a 3D Martian environment featuring Mission Control, a Science Laboratory, Habitat Pod, Airlock and Rover Operations.

Beginning on SOL 1, players must restore reactor power, conduct scientific experiments and establish mining operations. They monitor oxygen, water, food, energy and materials through a connected mission-control dashboard.

IVY, our virtual mission assistant, provides operational guidance, while an interactive rover introduces robotic planetary exploration.

NASA Resources

NASA's Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover mission informed our exploration activities, scientific objectives and educational content.

Technology and Innovation

We developed SindyLink using Unreal Engine 5, Blueprints, Blender, JavaScript, Node.js, HTML, CSS and REST APIs, with GitHub for version control and Render for web hosting. AI tools assisted development and selected creative assets.

Our innovation combines immersive 3D gameplay with a custom-built web-based mission-management system, connecting exploration with operational decision-making.

Impact and Design

SindyLink encourages problem-solving, scientific curiosity, resource awareness and digital literacy. We prioritised engaging gameplay, age-appropriate learning, scientific relevance and technical performance.

Our vision is to expand the experience into classrooms and immersive learning environments, making space exploration accessible to future scientists, engineers and astronauts.
